text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen witnessed an 
unprecedented surge of excitement. Great 
expectations were placed upon Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki responded to the cheering fans 
with a smile. However, watching her, Hishi 
Amazon realized something was different 
about her.
